arxiv-2110-15408.title: DPUR/TH/72
arxiv-2110-15408.creator: October, 2021
arxiv-2110-15408.description: Abstract We consider a generic scale invariant scalar quantum field theory and its symmetry breakdown. Based on the dimension counting identity, we give a concise proof that dilaton is exactly massless at the classical level if scale invariance is broken spontaneously.

arxiv-2301-04802.title: Diffusion-based Data Augmentation for Skin Disease Classification: Impact Across Original Medical Datasets to Fully Synthetic Images
arxiv-2301-04802.creator: Mohamed Akrout ∗, Bálint Gyepesi ∗, Péter Holló, Adrienn Poór, Blága Kincső, Stephen Solis, Katrina Cirone, Jeremy Kawahara, Dekker Slade, Latif Abid, Máté Kovács, István Fazekas
arxiv-2301-04802.description: Abstract Despite continued advancement in recent years, deep neural networks still rely on large amounts of training data to avoid overfitting. However, labeled training data for real-world applications such as healthcare is limited and difficult to access given longstanding privacy, and strict data sharing policies.

arxiv-2302-05554.title: On the use of static analysis to engage students with software quality improvement: An experience with PMD
arxiv-2302-05554.creator: Eman Abdullah AlOmar 1 , Salma Abdullah AlOmar, Mohamed Wiem Mkaouer 2
arxiv-2302-05554.description: Abstract Static analysis tools are frequently used to scan the source code and detect deviations from the project coding guidelines. Given their importance, linters are often introduced to classrooms to educate students on how to detect and potentially avoid these code anti-patterns .

arxiv-2407-10820.title: Enabling MCTS Explainability for Sequential Planning Through Computation Tree Logic
arxiv-2407-10820.creator: Ziyan An, Hendrik Baier, Abhishek Dubey, Ayan Mukhopadhyay, Meiyi Ma
arxiv-2407-10820.description: Abstract Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS) is one of the most capable online search algorithms for sequential planning tasks, with significant applications in areas such as resource allocation and transit planning. Despite its strong performance in real-world deployment, the inherent complexity of MCTS makes it challenging to understand for users without technical background.

arxiv-2510-04068.title: YITP-25-156 Characteristic polynomials of tensors via Grassmann integrals and distributions of roots for random Gaussian tensors
arxiv-2510-04068.creator: Nicolas Delporte, Giacomo La Scala, Naoki Sasakura, Reiko Toriumi
arxiv-2510-04068.description: Abstract We propose a new definition of characteristic polynomials of tensors based on a partition function of Grassmann variables. This new notion of characteristic polynomial addresses general tensors including totally antisymmetric ones, but not totally symmetric ones. Drawing an analogy with matrix eigenvalues obtained from the roots of their characteristic polynomials, we study the roots of our tensor characteristic polynomial.

pmc-10558518.title: Ground truth based comparison of saliency maps algorithms
pmc-10558518.creator: Karolina Szczepankiewicz, Adam Popowicz, Kamil Charkiewicz, Katarzyna Nałęcz-Charkiewicz, Michał Szczepankiewicz, Sławomir Lasota, Paweł Zawistowski, Krystian Radlak
pmc-10558518.description: Deep neural networks (DNNs) have achieved outstanding results in domains such as image processing, computer vision, natural language processing and bioinformatics. In recent years, many methods have been proposed that can provide a visual explanation of decision made by such classifiers. Saliency maps are probably the most popular.

pmc-10604608.title: Pharmacological Akt and JNK Kinase Inhibitors 10-DEBC and SP600125 Potentiate Anti-Glioblastoma Effect of Menadione and Ascorbic Acid Combination in Human U251 Glioblastoma Cells
pmc-10604608.creator: Ana Despotović, Kristina Janjetović, Nevena Zogović, Gordana Tovilović-Kovačević, Jason K Sa
pmc-10604608.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Glioblastoma multiforme (GBM) is the most lethal primary brain tumor in adults, characterized by a highly invasive nature and therapy resistance. Combination of menadione and ascorbic acid (AA+MD) exerts strong ROS-mediated anti-GBM activity in vitro. The objective of this study was to improve AA+MD anti-GBM potential by modulating the activity of Akt and c-Jun N-terminal kinase (JNK), molecules with an important role in GBM development.

pmc-10685023.title: Molecular characterization and immune protective efficacy of 3 Eimeria tenella antigens
pmc-10685023.creator: Lei Zhang, Zhixuan Song, Peiyao Li, Xingju Song, Xinming Tang, Dandan Hu
pmc-10685023.description: Avian coccidiosis caused by Eimeria is a serious parasitic disease that poses a threat to the poultry industry. Currently, prevention and treatment mainly rely on the administration of anticoccidials and live oocyst vaccines. However, the prevalence of drug resistance and the inherent limitations of live vaccines have driven the development of novel vaccines.

pmc-11330959.title: Clinical decision making in prostate cancer care—evaluation of EAU-guidelines use and novel decision support software
pmc-11330959.creator: C. Engesser, M. Henkel, V. Alargkof, S. Fassbind, J. Studer, J. Engesser, M. Walter, A. Elyan, S. Dugas, P. Trotsenko, S. Sutter, C. Eckert, S. Hofmann, A. Stalder, H. Seifert, P. Cornford, B. Stieltjes, C. Wetterauer
pmc-11330959.description: Keeping up to date with the latest clinical advances in prostate cancer can be challenging. We investigated the impact of guideline use on quality of treatment decisions as well as the impact of a novel, CE-certified clinical decision support tool (Siemens AIPC software) on the amount of time clinicians spend on decision-making in a multicenter setting.

pmc-11681479.title: Antiphospholipid Antibodies Modify the Prognostic Value of Baseline Platelet Count for Clinical Outcomes After Ischemic Stroke
pmc-11681479.creator: Yinan Wang, Pinni Yang, Zhengbao Zhu, Hao Peng, Xiaoqing Bu, Qingyun Xu, Aili Wang, Jing Chen, Tan Xu, Yonghong Zhang, Jiang He
pmc-11681479.description: BackgroundAntiphospholipid antibodies (aPLs) have been reported to be involved in platelet‐mediated thrombosis and inflammation, but the impact on the prognosis of ischemic stroke remains unclear. We aimed to examine whether the association between baseline platelet count (PLT) and long‐term clinical outcomes within 2 years after ischemic stroke onset is modulated by aPLs.
